title: Document ingestion
description: Normalize text, Markdown, PDF, DOCX and CSV with exact provenance and optional isolated OCR.

env.name: KIT_OCR_ENABLED
env.description: Set true only after configuring the Python OCR worker.

env.name: KIT_OCR_PYTHON
env.description: Absolute server-side Python executable path with OCR extra installed.

systemRequirements: Node >=22; optional OCR requires Python 3.12 and Tesseract

steps: Read the eight-question README and select this module with kit create or kit add.
Keep server entrypoints in server routes; validate incoming boundaries and show local/live mode.

modes.local: Deterministic local implementation with original synthetic fixtures; no external calls.
modes.live: Real configured adapters require explicit operator credentials and intent; no silent fixture fallback.

verification.local: Behavioral tests passed 2026-10-09; see README and final integration report.
verification.exported: Passed 2026-10-09: standalone full recipe npm ci, types, module tests, build and local HTTP run; provider verification is separate.
verification.live: not run — requires operator test credentials and authorization

limitations: PDF layout/table reconstruction is approximate; mixed scanned pages require explicit OCR.
UTF-8 text only; untrusted native parsing should run in a constrained worker.
cost: Local CPU only; hosting/persistence costs depend on deployment.
provenance: Original implementation and synthetic fixtures created for Hackathon Kit; third-party package licenses retained. Base revision 0fcd52a.
